sources.1: USER: editable-control committed state, including accessibility

interfaces.name: pulse.dispatch
interfaces.thread: post/cancel may run on any thread; Query and callbacks run on owner UI thread
interfaces.ordering: callback may begin before post returns; callbacks are not nested
interfaces.cancellation: OK guarantees callback cannot subsequently begin; STATE is not permission to free running userdata
interfaces.shutdown: host stop suppresses pending work; plugin must join producers before destroy returns; context lives through destroy

interfaces.name: pulse.ui.model
interfaces.sharedOperations: All UI creation, state and lifetime operations use this single table
interfaces.fieldMapping: C snake_case fields map to existing UiTree camelCase; data_columns maps DataTable columns; optional present=0 means absent. Header declares every field and borrowed array type.
interfaces.copying: All strings/arrays copied synchronously into a temporary in-memory DOM for shared validation; no JSON text serialization/parsing; not zero-copy
interfaces.events: Declared native command IDs, including menu/close/filter/sort/row, use subscribe_command; callback string is command ID, not node ID. Local actions update state without native callbacks.
interfaces.validationStatus: 27 general-purpose types represented; does not assert every interaction or theme/DPI capture passed

interfaces.name: pulse.ui.data
interfaces.binding: Bind an existing empty pulse.ui.model data node with initially empty selection. Configured state keys must exist, have distinct roles and not overlap selection; initial sort is nameAsc/nameDesc. Uses the shared renderer/data controller. bind does not start a request; successful model update requires rebind.
interfaces.thread: publish may run on any thread; all other operations and request/cancel callbacks run on owner UI thread
interfaces.copying: Request views expire at callback return. publish synchronously copies all borrowed page strings/arrays and never invokes plugin code. PULSE_OK means copied/queued, not displayed.
interfaces.requests: REFRESH starts a live stream. Filter/sort changes cancel/restart it. NEXT_PAGE cancels the previous stream and requests its cursor; revision must match.
interfaces.snapshot: SNAPSHOT publishes at most page_size top-level rows. READY requires a nonempty revision; LOADING/ERROR carry no rows/cursor/delta and ERROR requires error text. Row semantics match PulseUiModelRow; commands must be declared native commands.
interfaces.delta: READY DELTA requires an established snapshot and base_revision matching displayed revision. Upsert stable row IDs and remove top-level IDs; descendant tree changes replace their top-level ancestor. Not allowed for a next-page stream; clears pagination.
interfaces.state: Configured keys expose initial empty/loading/error, refresh, pagination and deltas. Stale revisions and row/inbox overflow become error states; inbox overflow fails the stream until refresh.
interfaces.cancellation: Cancel invalidates a request before its callback; later publish returns STATE. Successful model update, close, stop, unregister and unbind cancel requests. Unbind clears rows and selection. Providers remain until unregister or stop; all handles are plugin-instance scoped.
interfaces.shutdown: Callbacks return promptly and only signal worker cancellation; plugin owns/joins workers before destroy returns. Host context lives through destroy, not after it. No exceptions cross the ABI.
interfaces.validationStatus: Published author contract; host functional/UI verification requires separate evidence and is not implied by this catalog

interfaces.name: pulse.directories
interfaces.thread: All calls and callbacks run on owner UI thread; filesystem enumeration and watch I/O run on host workers
interfaces.resourceDeclarationPolicy: Installation disclosure only; not a per-call permission gate
interfaces.paths: Absolute drive/UNC paths only; device, virtual and relative paths are rejected
interfaces.snapshots: Immutable, never silently truncated. Successful refresh replaces the snapshot; failure preserves it. Snapshot and entry IDs are owner/directory/snapshot bound, not persistent file IDs. list uses explicit offset against the requested snapshot; next_offset UINT32_MAX marks exhaustion.
interfaces.callbacks: PULSE_OK accepts work; completion callbacks are deferred. Reply strings and row arrays are borrowed only through callback return; copy them before returning.
interfaces.errors: Check immediate PulseStatus and deferred reply.status/system_error/error. Accepted work is not completed enumeration; stale snapshot/entry identities are rejected.
interfaces.watch: Coalesced invalidations, not an exact change journal. After WATCH_READY refresh once, then refresh on INVALIDATED or overflow to avoid an arm gap. Sequence is notification ordering, not a lossless filesystem journal.
interfaces.openEntry: Resolves a current snapshot entry and dispatches Pulse normal navigation/open routing. Success is route acceptance, not external application launch or document execution completion.
interfaces.cancellation: close/cancel/unwatch immediately suppress future callbacks; an on-stack callback may finish. Stop does not wait for filesystem I/O on UI thread.
interfaces.shutdown: No exceptions cross ABI. Context remains valid through plugin destroy and expires afterwards.
interfaces.validationStatus: Author contract only; functional/UI acceptance requires separate host evidence

interfaces.name: pulse.context
interfaces.thread: All calls and callbacks run on owner UI thread
interfaces.resourceDeclarationPolicy: Installation disclosure only; not a per-call permission gate
interfaces.snapshot: get/subscribe observe owner's already loaded summary without enumerating files or selections. get_selection synchronously copies loaded selection paths/names/directory flags and directory, with selection_revision; no disk access. Empty ordinary-directory selection succeeds. Loading returns STATE; unsupported views or limits return UNAVAILABLE without truncation. Loading clears selection summary. Revisions are monotonic per attachment; selection_revision exposes multi-selection changes even when count/name summary stays identical.
interfaces.callbacks: get calls back synchronously and retains neither callback nor user pointer. subscribe has deferred initial delivery and coalesces changes at the 30 ms session tick; not every change is delivered. Borrowed strings and selection arrays expire at callback return; copy before starting worker work. Recursive reads are rejected.
interfaces.errors: Check immediate PulseStatus; get does not retain callbacks on return. A successful subscription is observation, not an enumeration or a lossless event stream.
interfaces.cancellation: unsubscribe/stop suppress future callbacks; an on-stack callback may finish
interfaces.shutdown: Context lives through plugin destroy. No C++ exceptions cross ABI callbacks.
interfaces.validationStatus: Author contract only; functional/UI acceptance requires separate host evidence

interfaces.name: pulse.fileops
interfaces.thread: All calls use the owner UI thread

operationContract.copy: Current selection to the other visible pane
operationContract.move: Current selection to the other visible pane
operationContract.deleteToRecycleBin: Current ordinary-file selection; host rejects items that cannot be recycled
operationContract.copyToDirectory: Current selection to a successfully opened directory handle in the same attachment
operationContract.moveToDirectory: Current selection to a successfully opened directory handle in the same attachment
operationContract.copyEntriesToDirectory: Current immutable snapshot entry IDs from an opened directory to an opened directory in the same attachment
operationContract.moveEntriesToDirectory: Current immutable snapshot entry IDs from an opened directory to an opened directory in the same attachment
operationContract.copyDirectoryTreeToDirectory: Copy one ordinary current-snapshot directory entry recursively to a new destination directory; never replace or merge

interfaces.destinationLifetime: Closing a directory handle cancels preparation/confirmation before task submission; afterward cancellation uses the request ID. Refresh preserves the handle. Paths resolve at worker preparation; controlled object identity applies after preparation.
interfaces.confirmation: Always uses Pulse native confirmation before mutation; plugin cannot bypass or supply confirmation
interfaces.progress: get returns a synchronous task-owned snapshot; request and task IDs are attachment-owned
interfaces.cancellation: Cancel signals preparation/confirmation/task cancellation; completed filesystem effects are not rolled back
interfaces.validationStatus: Author contract only; real host operation acceptance requires separate behavior evidence
interfaces.sourceSnapshot: submit_entries accepts only unique ordinary non-reparse file entry IDs from the exact current snapshot; size and modified time are revalidated during worker preparation. Refresh or either handle closing before task submission cancels preparation/confirmation.
interfaces.resultLifetime: Native accepted requests retain their exact task result until terminal get consumes it or the attachment closes; owner/package-bound retention is bounded by the 32-request attachment limit.
interfaces.treeTransfer: submit_directory_tree accepts one ordinary folder from the exact current snapshot and copies it to a new root named after its source leaf. Limits: 128 directories, 512 files, 1 MiB of plan paths. get_item returns each file's relative path and terminal result. Directories remain visible even if a later file fails; no rollback is implied.

interfaces.name: pulse.ui.mount
interfaces.thread: All calls and callbacks run on owner UI thread
interfaces.panel: Uses the existing pulse.ui.model panel; moving preserves the HWND, tree, state, subscriptions and data bindings.
interfaces.ownership: One native occupant per owner sidebar/workspace slot, multiple independent owned windows. Busy slots fail without replacing the occupant. Closing, stopping or destroying owner releases the slot.
interfaces.events: Deferred initial snapshot; size, DPI, theme, focus and placement changes coalesce per host turn. Callbacks can move, close or unsubscribe without nesting.
interfaces.narrowLayout: Unavailable dock geometry falls back to an owned window; get and callbacks report actual placement.
pending: arbitrary toolbar UI surfaces (command buttons use pulse.commands)

interfaces.name: pulse.commands
interfaces.thread: Owner UI thread; register during plugin entry, before panel activation
interfaces.conditions: Selection count range, allowed file/directory kinds and lowercase dotted extension include/exclude list; every selected entry must match
interfaces.invocation: Host rechecks conditions and captures current loaded selection before invoking; snapshot strings/arrays borrowed only through callback return
interfaces.shortcuts: Owner main UI only, not global hotkeys; built-in shortcuts take precedence; editors do not dispatch plugin shortcuts; duplicate owner shortcuts rejected
interfaces.toolbar: Stable native:package:command identity persists in existing toolbar_tools; menu tokens are transient
interfaces.lifecycle: Unregister/stop invalidates tokens; IDs never reused; host waits for active callbacks before unloading

interfaces.name: pulse.preview
interfaces.thread: Register/unregister on owner UI thread during entry. Provider callback runs on a host worker, at most two concurrent calls per instance; synchronize shared userdata. Never call UI APIs from provider callbacks.
interfaces.model: PULSE_PREVIEW_UI_MODEL uses borrowed PulseUiModelTree* model. Host converts and copies on the provider worker; Quick Preview and Details use existing docked controls. Local state/actions are supported; command_count > 0 returns UNAVAILABLE. Limits: 128 nodes, depth 8, 64 KiB. Non-null data_source, context.* bindings and action.data_operation remain unsupported.
interfaces.publish: Call request.publish on the callback worker. It synchronously copies borrowed result strings, entries, pixels and UI model. At most one successful publish per callback; returning OK without a result fails. Request and contexts expire when callback returns.
interfaces.bitmap: Premultiplied BGRA, positive dimensions, stride >= width*4 and byte_count == stride*height within limits.
interfaces.cancellation: Poll request.cancelled during work and return promptly. Cancellation discards results; stale selection results are not displayed. Unregister retires immediately and returns STATE while callbacks drain; retain userdata and retry on UI thread until OK or retain through destroy. Stop retains the DLL until all provider callbacks return.
interfaces.errors: No exceptions cross ABI. Check publish status. Do not retain request/publish/cancel contexts, call UI APIs from workers, or free memory owned by the other side.
interfaces.validationStatus: P1.3 archive/bitmap/UI-model host acceptance recorded in implementation roadmap; extraction tasks remain separate

interfaces.name: pulse.tasks
interfaces.thread: create/cancel/get/release and cancellation callbacks use owner UI thread; work uses host workers; progress report is any-thread and never calls host UI backend
interfaces.progress: Copied percent (0..100 or UINT32_MAX indeterminate), completed/total item and byte counts, current_item and error; completed counters and determinate percent are monotonic and cannot exceed totals
interfaces.completion: Worker return selects an immutable terminal state; cancellation does not override explicit failure or completion. Report remains accepted during cleanup until worker returns, allowing cleanup failure diagnostics
interfaces.cancellation: Exact task ID, cooperative cancellation flag; on_cancel delivered once on UI before terminal publication. Cancellation is not rollback
interfaces.lifetime: Keep userdata until get observes terminal, release succeeds, or destroy. Close cancels; DLL remains loaded until workers, cancellation callbacks and UI terminal publication finish. get strings borrowed only through callback
interfaces.retention: release terminal records explicitly; create at capacity may evict oldest terminal; IDs never reused
interfaces.validationStatus: Task lifecycle and host acceptance are recorded in the implementation roadmap; output staging and commit remain separate

interfaces.name: pulse.staging
interfaces.thread: choose_destination synchronous owner UI; create callback and create/commit/release disk work on host workers; get callback synchronous caller thread; commit confirmation/submission on owner UI
interfaces.destination: Existing ordinary local drive directory; private hidden host-created staging directory beneath destination preserves volume. choose_destination uses the standard host folder picker.
interfaces.commit: Join writers before commit. Host validates nonempty ordinary tree, rejects reparse points and repeated commit, then confirms and submits standard file operations. Snapshot task_id identifies submitted operation; acceptance is not completion.
interfaces.lifetime: Borrowed callback strings expire on return. Finish writers before release. Close blocks create/commit/choose; get/cancel/release remain valid through destroy. Close never removes writer output; remaining cleanup starts after destroy.
interfaces.cleanup: ID-only asynchronous release for unsubmitted or terminal stage; successful cleanup removes the ID. Cancel is cooperative and not rollback.

interfaces.name: pulse.settings.pages
interfaces.thread: Owner UI thread for all calls and callbacks
interfaces.presentation: One existing native UI-model tree embedded under the host extension settings section; independent of the main plugin panel
interfaces.query: Dedicated pulse.ui.model and pulse.ui.events tables; page IDs are panel IDs. No mount/data interfaces
interfaces.lifetime: Title/model arrays and strings copied synchronously; borrowed callback values expire at callback return. remove/stop invalidate page IDs and subscriptions. Keep callback userdata until callbacks return; dedicated contexts retained through session destroy
interfaces.persistence: Use existing pulse.resources settings_get/settings_set with expected_version. Acceptance is not save completion; version_conflict never overwrites. Reload current revision, retain draft and require explicit retry
interfaces.sample: Archive destination and future compression format/level preferences; compression remains unimplemented
interfaces.validationStatus: P1.6 settings lifecycle and real-host persistence/conflict/theme/scroll acceptance recorded in the implementation roadmap

interfaces.name: pulse.dialogs
interfaces.thread: Owner UI thread for all calls and callbacks; show returns at once and the dialog answers later
interfaces.presentation: Host-drawn Fluent modal over the owner window: title, optional message, optional UI-model form, 1-3 footer buttons (standard/primary/danger). Text inputs with kind password are masked.
interfaces.lifetime: Model and strings copied by show. closed runs exactly once with every declared state unless the session stops first; borrowed values expire at callback return.
interfaces.sample: extensions/7zip: password prompt, compression options and checksum results

files.description: Additional package files. Flat non-reserved ASCII filenames, no trailing dot or case-insensitive duplicates including the entry DLL. Each file <=64 MiB; whole package <=256 MiB.

packageStore.authorCommand: pulse_ext.py --pulse HOST --json native-manifest TEMPLATE --library DLL [--file DEPENDENCY_OR_RESOURCE ...] --output MANIFEST
packageStore.consent: Install, enable and rollback require explicit --allow-native, including new binary hashes. Native code executes inside Pulse with the user's process privileges; capability declarations are not a sandbox.
packageStore.dependencies: Up to 63 additional flat-name private DLLs/resources; each file is SHA-256 verified and locked until unload. Multi-file loads use DLL_LOAD_DIR and SYSTEM32. Whole-package size <=256 MiB.
packageStore.updates: Atomic binary publication precedes registry commit; restart Pulse to activate an update or rollback. Loaded native DLLs are never hot-replaced.

tools.name: native_project_create

tools.name: native_project_build
tools.description: Configure and build a workspace C++ project with CMake/Ninja and public SDK headers. Returns compiler diagnostics; no Pulse private libraries.

tools.name: native_package_stage
tools.description: Bind the compiled DLL hash, pack and verify a .pulse-ext package using the same Pulse author CLI.

tools.name: native_package_install
tools.description: Install a verified native package in this author workspace test store. Native consent must be explicit. Enable applies on next host startup.

tools.name: native_host_diagnose
tools.description: Compare this Pulse host native SDK catalog with the author SDK; return version mismatch diagnostics without loading a plugin.

tools.name: native_host_run
tools.description: Launch the configured host with an isolated author profile and test store. Returns the process ID and log path; launch acceptance does not certify plugin loading or UI behavior.
